dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Smokey is a beautiful, sweet boy that needs placement for medical reasons. He is not eating and lethargic due to a severe respiratory tract infection. He has significant inflammation in his lungs and upper airways which need supportive care in a veterinary hospital. He is receiving fluids and antibiotics intravenously to stimulate his recovery.
dog.name: Smokey
